en.title: See what needs attention first
en.summary: Alert colors now help the important things rise above the everyday noise.

items.title: Four clear levels
items.body: Use green, yellow, orange, or red to show how urgently an alert needs attention.

items.title: Priority you can spot instantly
items.body: Severity appears in both notifications and the inbox, while ordinary alerts stay clean and white.

zhHant.title: 一眼看出甚麼最重要
zhHant.summary: 提醒顏色讓重要事項自然浮現，不再被日常訊息淹沒。

items.title: 四個清楚等級
items.body: 用綠、黃、橙或紅色，表達提醒需要多快處理。

items.title: 優先次序一眼可見
items.body: 通知和收件箱都會顯示重要程度，一般提醒則保持簡潔白色。
